Causally backfill the frozen Tencent history without touching later rows. The
existing snapshot was sourced from Tencent Finance but intentionally began in
2022. This utility downloads bounded, non-overlapping 2014-2021 chunks,
validates each symbol against the first already-frozen row, and prepends only
dates earlier than that row. Existing 2022+ bytes are preserved verbatim.
